probes.label: windows_services
probes.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-Service -Name 'com.docker.service','docker','containerd','com.docker.build' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Status,StartType | Format-Table -AutoSize | Out-String"

probes.label: docker_desktop_paths
probes.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "@('C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe','C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\resources\bin\docker.exe','C:\Program Files\Rancher Desktop\Rancher Desktop.exe','C:\Program Files\RedHat\Podman\podman.exe') | ForEach-Object { '{0} => {1}' -f $_, (Test-Path -LiteralPath $_) }"
probes.output:
C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\Docker Desktop.exe => False
C:\Program Files\Docker\Docker\resources\bin\docker.exe => False
C:\Program Files\Rancher Desktop\Rancher Desktop.exe => False
C:\Program Files\RedHat\Podman\podman.exe => False

probes.label: windows_optional_features_containers
probes.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "foreach ($f in 'Containers','Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux','VirtualMachinePlatform') { try { $r = Get-WindowsOptionalFeature -Online -FeatureName $f -ErrorAction Stop; '{0} = {1}' -f $r.FeatureName, $r.State } catch { '{0} = 查询失败: {1}' -f $f, $_.Exception.Message } }"
probes.output:
Containers = 查询失败: 请求的操作需要提升。

Microsoft-Windows-Subsystem-Linux = 查询失败: 请求的操作需要提升。

VirtualMachinePlatform = 查询失败: 请求的操作需要提升。

probes.label: wsl_appx_package
probes.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "Get-AppxPackage -Name 'MicrosoftCorporationII.WindowsSubsystemForLinux' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object Name,Version,Status | Format-List | Out-String; 'appx_found=' + [bool](Get-AppxPackage -Name 'MicrosoftCorporationII.WindowsSubsystemForLinux' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)"
probes.output: appx_found=False

probes.label: wsl_distros_registry
probes.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "try { (Get-ChildItem 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Lxss' -ErrorAction Stop | ForEach-Object { $_.PSChildName }) -join ',' } catch { 'Lxss 注册表项不存在: ' + $_.Exception.Message }"
probes.output: Lxss 注册表项不存在: 找不到路径“HKEY_CURRENT_USER\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Lxss”，因为该路径不存在。
